thread:
mira (release): Quick flag: eu-west1 embeddings QPS dipped ~6% at 09:20. Triage indicates KV eviction storm. Requesting hotfix in 10m change window.

alex (sre): Ack. Prefer tiny canary but if traffic noise prevents it we'll need ENG+SRE+oncall for skip. Share image sha + smoke and rollback criteria.

chris (eng): Image gcr.redwood/embed:hotfix-7001@sha256:9f8e7d6. Patch reduces eviction aggressiveness and adds metric evict_guard. Staging perf and e2e clean.

leo (oncall): Oncall here, will monitor.

mira (release): Smoke checklist: 1) /health -> 200 2) p50 <= baseline +8ms 3) evict_guard trend down. Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate +2% for 90s OR p95 > baseline +150ms for 2m -> pin previous sha256:1122aabb and shift back.

alex (sre): +1 SRE given checklist + rollback. Prefer canary=5% for 90s then 100% if ok.

chris (eng): +1 ENG. I'll run deploy.

mira (release): OK deploying with canary 5% (90s) -> full. Release note: "hotfix: mitigate KV eviction spike in embeddings eu-west1; monitoring on; CS notified."

releasebot: Deploy request accepted. Plan: canary=5% (90s) -> 100%. Requirements: oncall ack + one approver satisfied.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout embed -> sha256:9f8e7d6; rollout id rl-7001234567-1; Canary 5% 90s.

leo (oncall): Watching logs. silencing noisy alerts for rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary 00:20: small 429 blip at +12s but below auto-hold threshold. p50 stable. evict_guard trending down.

alex (sre): Canary passed 90s. advancing to 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> success rl-7001234567-1.

mira (release): Thanks team. Follow-up: PR to add a canary guard for 429 spikes >0.5% to auto-hold. Tagging eng-triage.

chris (eng): Will open PR this afternoon.

alex (sre): Monitors in watch mode 24h. Closing unless regression appears. :white_check_mark:
